metadata.description: Coding-agent rules, skills, and hooks for Agentic AI Tools repositories, one plugin per stack.

plugins.name: feature-spec
plugins.description: Feature specifications as OKF concepts: write a spec from a prompt with design-repo context, citable item IDs allocated safely across machines, consistency review with deprecation of contradicted items, decomposition into parallel child specs, plan-mode prompts, and shared work claims on origin so parallel agents see each other's work. A hook checks edited specs.

plugins.name: genai-app
plugins.description: Repositories that call models: STRIDE-AI security rules for prompts, retrieval, model output, and tools, reliability and cost rules for model calls, and a skill for adding a model call safely.

plugins.name: okf-design
plugins.description: Open Knowledge Format v0.3 design bundles: reading from indexes, authoring concepts, and a skill that checks frontmatter, index descriptions, and links.

plugins.name: org-core
plugins.description: Organization rules for every Agentic AI Tools repository: branching, pull requests, TDD, lint before commit, commit attribution, secrets, the security and reliability baselines, and skills for threat models and runbooks.

plugins.name: postgres-flyway
plugins.description: Schema repositories and modules that own a schema: Flyway naming, forward-only additive migrations, migration safety and tenant isolation, Postgres conventions, and the migrations image.

plugins.name: python-service
plugins.description: FastAPI services and lifecycle modules: the technology stack and design patterns, security and reliability rules, skills for endpoints, ports, and store queries, and a ruff hook on edited Python files.

plugins.name: react-portal
plugins.description: Portals and SPAs: the UI foundations and components standard, web security and resilience rules, skills for pages and data tables, and an oxlint hook on edited files.

plugins.name: terraform-infra
plugins.description: Bootstrap and infrastructure repositories: module per shell, deployer-role scope, GitHub OIDC with immutable subjects, apply gates, resilience and edge security rules, and a terraform fmt hook.
